entry.content:

A poll of over 2,000 Bedroom Producers Blog (BPB) readers shows a preference for AI tools designed for specific technical tasks—such as stem separation, noise removal, and code assistance—while expressing strong opposition to AI music generators. entry.content:

NOMN is a Tokyo-based software studio that produces minimalist music production plugins, including a physical-modeling bubble synthesizer, a multi-layer MIDI generator, spatial processing tools, and a remote browser-based listening service. Its software features custom visual interfaces with support for formats such as VST3, AU, and MPE.

The studio's device lineup includes FOAM for modeling acoustic bubble dynamics, RESERVOIR for algorithmic MIDI composition using multiple rhythm engines, ANTIVERB for reflection-based density layering, and CHAKRABOOST for multi-band spatial panning. Priced between ¥7,777 and ¥11,111 with 14-day trials available, the plugins operate on macOS and Windows.

entry.title: Glow Shrimp Limiter Plugin Now Available Free
entry.content:
Links: bedroomproducersblog.com | glowshrimpsoftware.com

Developer Jesse Hufstetler’s Glow Shrimp Limiter is now available as a free download after previously being offered as commercial software. Originally developed in 2019 to reduce CPU usage and serve as a replacement for older 32-bit limiters within a REAPER workflow, the plugin features a minimalist interface with only gain and ceiling controls, alongside two switchable filters.

The Windows release includes both 32-bit and 64-bit VST2 and VST3 formats via a direct ZIP archive download without requiring an account or installer. However, users have noted compatibility and licensing hurdles with the older macOS build, and the interface omits standard visual aids like gain-reduction meters or loudness displays.

entry.title: Metaebene Applications Launches Kugelblitz 3D Globe and Atlas App for Mac
entry.content:
Links: apps.metaebene.me | hacker news

Kugelblitz is a macOS application developed by Metaebene that renders the Earth and neighboring celestial bodies as an interactive 3D globe and flat atlas using open geodata and OpenStreetMap tiles. Designed to run smoothly on Apple Silicon hardware, the software overlays aerial imagery, road maps, and topographic maps onto real terrain complete with 3D buildings.

The application includes support for external hardware controllers like the 3Dconnexion SpaceMouse, network-shared tile caching, Apple Vision Pro headset streaming, and historical data visualization for events such as solar eclipses and earthquakes. It operates entirely on freely available geodata sources without requiring user accounts or region-wide downloads.

entry.title: Native Instruments Releases Vertikal Virtual Grand Piano Instrument
entry.content:
Links: musictech.com | native-instruments.com

Native Instruments and Galaxy Instruments have released Vertikal, a new virtual instrument for Kontakt 8 that captures the sound of a 4.5-meter-tall vertical concert grand piano. Recorded by the piano's owner, Nils Frahm, at Berlin's Funkhaus studio complex, the instrument replicates the acoustics of the monumental instrument's massive resonant body and strings.

Vertikal offers three performance modes—pure, felt, and felt-plus-cotton—allowing users to switch between clear and softened textures. It is powered by a redesigned Particles 2.0 engine featuring refined rhythm patterns, an expanded sound source library, precise pan and timbre controls, and motion modulation systems supporting polyphonic aftertouch.

entry.title: OXO Synth2 Free Synth1 Recreation Available for macOS and iPad
entry.content:
Links: bedroomproducersblog.com | oxo-music.com

A new free, open-source virtual analog synthesizer recreates the classic Synth1 for macOS and iPad. Developed by OXO Music, the plugin uses AI-assisted modeling to replicate the original's audio output and parameter behavior, providing a native Apple Silicon alternative for modern systems. It is compatible with macOS 14 and iPadOS 17 in VST3, AU, and AUv3 formats.

The engine features two oscillators, a sub oscillator, FM, ring modulation, hard sync, and five filter types. Users can import existing .sy1 patches and ZIP banks to maintain compatibility with legacy sound collections. A Windows version is currently in development.

entry.title: Acon Digital Launches Restoration Suite 3
entry.content:
Links: kvraudio.com | acondigital.com

The Restoration Suite 3 toolkit features a new plug-in that automatically identifies audio defects and constructs a custom repair chain. By using an "Analyze" function, the software listens to a recording to detect issues such as broadband noise, hum, clicks, or clipping, then automatically configures the required modules and settings.

The suite includes updated versions of DeNoise 3, DeHum 3, DeClick 3, and DeClip 3, with DeNoise and DeHum introducing new machine learning–powered "Automatic" modes. The software is available as a standalone product with perpetual licensing or as part of the Acoustica 8 audio editor.

entry.title: Vibe Together Multiplayer Browser Music Sandbox Launches in Beta
entry.content:
Links: bedroomproducersblog.com | makevibestogether.com

Vibe Together is a browser-based multiplayer music sandbox developed by Manik Bhat that enables up to eight users to compose music collaboratively on a shared grid. Participants place and connect musical objects with wires to trigger sounds, utilizing distance for timing and color-coded pitch for melody creation.

The platform features a procedural music generation system, a custom synth engine supporting subtractive, wavetable, and FM synthesis, and arcade-inspired game modes. It operates on a free-to-start model with a $20 premium tier that unlocks unlimited saves and export capabilities, with a Steam edition planned for future release.
